_meta.purpose: Borrowed-trust resource library for Newsletter Earl, Section 2. Each person behind a Big Book principle, with real sub-20-minute touchpoints where they convey their own thinking. Organized people-first. Code filters by lever/principle and drops recently-used resources before the writing call; Earl picks the best fit from the survivors. Usage is stamped on send, never on draft generation.
_meta.selection_flow: 1) match principle to story  2) filter library to that principle's resources  3) drop anything used too recently (last_used)  4) inject survivors into the writing call  5) Earl picks best fit for the point made
_meta.book_excerpt_rule: Cite exact chapter and the segment within it. Never 'read the book.'
_meta.polarizing_rule: For polarizing public figures, anchor the link to the specific idea or work, never their broader platform.
_meta.verified_field: true only when a search or fetch confirmed the URL resolves to the right content and the length is under the ceiling.
